mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.case_id, d.purpose, d.recipient_email, d.subject, d.body, d.email_drafts_status, d.updated_at FROM email_drafts d JOIN cases c ON c.id = d.case_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE d.id = #{draftId} AND u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.users_status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT a.evidence_id FROM email_draft_attachments a WHERE a.email_draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY a.id
UPDATE email_drafts SET recipient_email = #{to}, subject = #{subject}, body = #{body}, email_drafts_status = 'FINALIZED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{draftId} RETURNING updated_at
SELECT e.file_path, e.original_filename FROM email_draft_attachments a JOIN case_evidences e ON e.id = a.evidence_id WHERE a.email_draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY a.id

SELECT attempt.id, attempt.email_draft_id, attempt.email_send_attempts_status, attempt.gmail_message_id, attempt.gmail_thread_id, attempt.sent_at, attempt.error_message, attempt.message_id_header, message.id AS message_id FROM email_send_attempts AS attempt JOIN email_drafts AS draft ON draft.id = attempt.email_draft_id LEFT JOIN case_email_threads AS thread ON thread.case_id = draft.case_id AND thread.gmail_connection_id = attempt.gmail_connection_id AND thread.gmail_thread_id = attempt.gmail_thread_id LEFT JOIN email_messages AS message ON message.case_email_thread_id = thread.id AND message.gmail_message_id = attempt.gmail_message_id AND attempt.email_send_attempts_status = 'SENT' WHERE attempt.email_draft_id = #{draftId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_send_attempts (email_draft_id, gmail_connection_id, request_key, message_id_header) SELECT id, #{connectionId}, #{requestKey}, #{messageIdHeader} FROM email_drafts WHERE id = #{draftId} AND email_drafts_status = 'FINALIZED' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE email_drafts SET email_drafts_status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{draftId}

UPDATE email_send_attempts SET email_send_attempts_status = #{status}, gmail_message_id = #{gmailMessageId}, gmail_thread_id = #{gmailThreadId}, error_message = #{errorCode}, sent_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SENT' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND email_send_attempts_status = 'SENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, subject, email_drafts_status, updated_at FROM email_drafts WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_drafts (case_id, purpose, recipient_email, subject, body) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{purpose}, #{recipientEmail}, #{subject}, #{body})
mapper.select: SELECT id, case_id, purpose, recipient_email, subject, body, email_drafts_status, created_at, updated_at FROM email_drafts WHERE id = #{draftId}
SELECT id, case_id, purpose, recipient_email, subject, body, email_drafts_status, created_at, updated_at FROM email_drafts WHERE id = #{draftId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE email_drafts AS draft SET recipient_email = #{recipientEmail}, subject = #{subject}, body = #{body}, email_drafts_status = 'DRAFT', updated_at = now() WHERE draft.id = #{id} AND draft.email_drafts_status IN ('DRAFT', 'FINALIZED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM email_send_attempts AS attempt WHERE attempt.email_draft_id = draft.id AND attempt.email_send_attempts_status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN', 'SENT') )
UPDATE email_drafts SET email_drafts_status = 'FINALIZED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{draftId} AND email_drafts_status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE email_drafts AS draft SET email_drafts_status = 'SENT', updated_at = now() WHERE draft.id = #{draftId} AND draft.email_drafts_status = 'FINALIZED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM email_send_attempts AS attempt WHERE attempt.email_draft_id = draft.id AND attempt.email_send_attempts_status = 'SENT' )
